description: This source file defines the ChatMarkdownPreprocessor utility for processing markdown chat messages. It includes functions for stripping envelope headers, message ID hints, inbound context blocks, timestamps, and parsing embedded images from markdown.

classes.name: InlineImage
classes.description: A struct representing an inline image with a label and optional image data.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: A struct representing the processed markdown result with cleaned text and associated images.

methods.name: preprocess
methods.description: Main method to process input markdown text by applying multiple stripping functions and image parsing.

methods.name: inlineImage
methods.description: Helper to decode a base64-encoded image embedded in markdown.

methods.name: fallbackImageLabel
methods.description: Returns a fallback label for images with empty or whitespace labels.

methods.name: stripEnvelope
methods.description: Removes envelope headers from the raw message if detected.

methods.name: looksLikeEnvelopeHeader
methods.description: Checks if a header string resembles an envelope header based on date format or channel prefix.

methods.name: stripMessageIdHints
methods.description: Removes message ID hints from the message text.

methods.name: stripInboundContextBlocks
methods.description: Removes inbound context blocks and fenced JSON sections from the message.

methods.name: shouldStripTrailingUntrustedContext
methods.description: Determines whether to remove trailing untrusted context based on specific patterns.

methods.name: stripPrefixedTimestamps
methods.description: Removes timestamp prefixes from the message text.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes line endings and removes excessive blank lines.
